verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's API supports listing faults and BadgerQL queries, and the CLI/API could be scripted to act on many errors, but there's no documented bulk-action endpoint (e.g., bulk resolve/ignore/tag many faults in one call) or explicit bulk-operations feature in the docs. missing for 10: a documented bulk-update/bulk-resolve API or UI feature, evidence of batch operations across many items in one call, independent confirmation of bulk workflows in practice.
